heroLead: Two spinning reels. Unexpected combinations. A whole lot of funny Mixes.
heroNote: Real gameplay. Real surprises. No wrong answers.
mixDesc: Turn either reel and see what happens when two words—and two pictures—collide. Every combination is a new discovery.
mixOne: A real mix, straight from the game.
mixTwo: Not just animals. Cities get wonderfully mixed up, too.
albumTitle: Too good to forget? Save it.
albumDesc: Tap the heart on a mix you love. Your favorites stay together in My Magic Album, ready to revisit whenever you want.
workDesc: Explore themed word packs, or make a custom pack with your own words and photos. The first custom pack is free.
endDesc: For curious kids, playful grown-ups, and anyone who thinks language is more fun when you bend the rules.
status: Store links will appear when the release is ready.
foot: Made for mixing words, not following rules.
